operative_text:
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1359(a)(2)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1359(a)(2), is amended by deleting "§ 39-17-1351" and substituting "§ 39-17-1307(g)".
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1359(b)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1359(b), is amended by deleting subdivision (4).
SECTION 5 (TCA 39-17-1359(c)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1359(c), is amended by deleting the subsection.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1352(a)(6)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1352(a)(6), is amended by deleting "§ 39-17-1360" and substituting "§ 39-17-1353".
